events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur's Death
events.blurb: Legendary rapper Tupac Shakur died on September 13, 1996, six days after being critically wounded in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, a voice that continues to resonate decades after his tragic passing.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Iconic guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away in London on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, whose revolutionary guitar playing continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring iconic tracks like 'Something' and 'Here Comes The Sun'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles walked across that zebra crossing and delivered a masterpiece. What’s your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! An absolute legend.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis legend and acclaimed solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad Fer It Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the iconic Liam Gallagher. Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: The timeless message of peace from John Lennon's 'Imagine' still resonates, 51 years since its UK single release.

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember when you could fit 1,000 songs in your pocket? Happy 25th anniversary to the original iPod!

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the release date of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Grab your martini, it's James Bond Day! Celebrating over 60 years of cinematic espionage and iconic theme tunes.

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles co-founder and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: A tribute to the visionary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His message of peace lives on.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary English actor and comedian, John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! What’s your favourite sketch or character?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: 58 years of 'The White Album'! Dive into the sprawling, diverse, and often experimental tracks of The Beatles' iconic double LP.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Immortal Voice
angles.copy: A tribute to the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly immortal.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965, showcasing a new level of lyrical and musical sophistication.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly stretched the boundaries of pop and rock.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon, who was murdered on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: Reflecting on the profound impact of John Lennon's life and music, tragically cut short 46 years ago today.
